create_chat_completion.title: Create a chat completion
create_chat_completion.description: Send a conversation and get a model's reply. The request is OpenAI-compatible -- messages carry role and content, tools declares functions the model may call, and the response arrives as choices with a usage block of prompt and completion tokens.

model.description: Model id to run, e.g. deepseek/deepseek-v3.2.

messages.description: Conversation so far, each entry with a role and content.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature between 0 and 2. Defaults to 1.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate in the reply.

tools.description: Function definitions the model may call, in OpenAI tool format.

stream.description: True to ask for server-sent events; the reply still arrives complete here.

output.description: The completion, with choices, finish reason and token usage.

list_models.title: List available models
list_models.description: Read the models Avian currently serves, each with its id, context length, maximum output, whether it reasons, and its per-million input, output and cache-read prices.

output.description: The model catalogue with context lengths and pricing.
